source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Refer to the advertised specifications.
3. Compare advertised specifications with actual test results.
4. Clearly identify the discrepancies.
5. Use precise and quantitative data to back up your findings.
6. Include the dates and conditions of the tests.
7. Provide photographic or video evidence if available.
8. Use clear and concise language for the written report.
9. Where possible, present comparisons in tabular or graphical form for better understanding.
10. Describe the methodology used to measure performance.
11. State the units of measurement precisely.
12. Clearly outline what the advertised specification promised.
13. Highlight any conditions or caveats attached to the advertised specifications that were not met during testing.
14. Indicate the sample size and whether it was a one-off test or a multiple test series.
15. Ensure the accuracy of the reported findings by peer-reviewing or using second-party validation.
16. Clearly state if there is any ambiguity in the advertised claims.
17. Document
